narrativeBlocks.title: The scene
narrativeBlocks.body: Medea is caught between her household and her desire to help Jason. Apollonius gives sustained attention to her distress and deliberation, while divine intervention also shapes her desire. Her aid is decisive, but her freedom is not uncomplicated.

narrativeBlocks.title: Why it matters
narrativeBlocks.body: Interpretation: Her expertise is not an accessory to the hero; without it, Jason’s quest fails, and with it his public achievement becomes possible.

narrativeBlocks.title: Read it carefully
narrativeBlocks.body: Keep two pressures in view: Medea’s deliberation matters, and divine influence also matters. Neither treating her as a passive prize nor describing an entirely unpressured choice captures Apollonius’ presentation.

narrativeBlocks.title: Carry it forward
narrativeBlocks.body: This is why Euripides can later return to her betrayal with such force.
